_comment: Infrastructure config for fault injection tests. Registers helpdesk-test as a test-environment database so the k8s agent's resolveNamespaceInfo allows it.

pgbackrest-db-ssh._comment: Same real container as pgbackrest-db, reached over SSH instead of docker exec — tests agents/sysadmin's SSH-dispatch path for pgBackRest specifically, not just the generic SSH mechanism (already covered by sshexec_test.go's synthetic server). connection_string's port is the SSH port (15436), not the Postgres port (15435, same as pgbackrest-db) — deliberately distinct so port-based target resolution can't confuse the two entries; nothing here actually dials this port via psql, it's only used for infra-config matching. systemd_unit below is a placeholder only: resolveHost requires it for any non-docker/podman VM runtime, but pgBackRest's own SSH dispatch never reads it.
pgbackrest-db-ssh.name: pgBackRest Fault Test Database (SSH)

pgbackrest-ubuntu-vm._comment: Real Ubuntu 24.04 (noble) host/VM, not a Docker container — PostgreSQL 16 + pgBackRest installed via testing/docker/setup-pgbackrest-vm.sh, reached over real SSH as the systemd/VM dispatch path (runtime left empty on the vms entry below). Backs db-pgdata-corrupted-vm.
pgbackrest-ubuntu-vm.name: pgBackRest Real Ubuntu VM

pgbackrest-vm-ssh._comment: Same container as pgbackrest-vm, reached over real SSH (port 15436) instead of docker exec — exercises agents/sysadmin's SSH-dispatch path (sshexec.go) against real pgBackRest for the first time outside sshexec_test.go's synthetic server.
pgbackrest-vm-ssh.name: pgBackRest Fault Test VM (SSH)
